crack: Check depth: shallow -> scarf/grind, deep -> scrap. Review mould level, secondary cooling, casting speed.
scale: Descale before rolling; check reheating furnace atmosphere and soak time.
pinhole: Grind/scarf if shallow; check deoxidation and mould powder moisture.
inclusion: Send sample for lab check; improve ladle/tundish cleanliness and slag control.
scratch: Usually cosmetic; check guide rollers and handling contact points.
